findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - the nightly or release full suite runs the new-client CI-selection test.
The two previously named expectations were updated, but the same obsolete-matrix failure remains in `tests/test_test_only_pull_requests_select_changed_files.py:80-84`. It reads the first `group:` line and passes it to `expression()`, which requires a GitHub expression (`tests/test_ci_limits_pull_requests_to_linux.py:14-17`). The single-group PR job has no matrix, so the first matching line is the full-suite job's literal `[1]`; the test fails and keeps the full-suite check red.
